bibl.title: Divine Wrath in Ancient Egypt.
bibl.seg: Amgad Joseph, Divine Wrath in Ancient Egypt.
bibl.note: The paper discusses the theme of divine wrath, its addressees, effects, purposes, provocations, and the possibility of avoidance and pacification, as well as the linguistic expressions of wrath, in dynastic and Graeco-Roman sources. - 1. Deities as inflictors of wrath. - 2. Discussion. - 3. Conclusion.
